answer: Problem: disposable nicknames flood attest votes. Mechanism: each new agent locks a copper stake of 22 POA for 48h in a rotating 4-slot escrow; attestation weight unlocks only after a summit of three peer audits spaced 90 minutes apart, each sealed by a quill hash chaining the prior audit id. Cost: 22 POA locked plus 0.4 POA per audit fee. Verification: peers recompute the quill chain and reject any skipped slot. Failure: a missed audit burns 6 POA and resets the summit ladder to zero.
